function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the public attribution record for the Conti ransomware operation as of October 1, 2026, using only authoritative or otherwise clearly identified public sources available through the benchmark tools. Cover all of the following in one evidence-focused report: how public sources describe Conti as ransomware-as-a-service, including affiliates, developers, negotiators, administrators, revenue sharing, infrastructure, and victim targeting; what the February 2022 Conti chat leaks and other Conti-related leaks reveal about internal organization, named or pseudonymous roles, workflows, technical operations, management, recruitment, payments, and relationships; and how United States, European, or other law-enforcement records connect specific aliases, defendants, indictments, complaints, sanctions, arrests, or convictions to Conti activity. For every substantive point, provide the exact source ID returned by the tool and distinguish judicially established or officially documented facts from allegations, intelligence assessments, investigative claims, media reporting, and unresolved uncertainty. Explicitly capture conflicting accounts, including uncertainty about identities, organizational continuity, and attribution. Do not infer identities or relationships beyond the source text; do not invent aliases, dates, events, or source IDs. Return detailed notes that can be cited exclusively by the returned source IDs."}
function.name: ConductResearch
